mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline from previous month values, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply chain disruption regime (INDPRO < 105.0), a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) signals improving supply conditions that enhance corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0 and INDPRO rises from previous month, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of consumer spending (RSAFS) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%), a rising employment level (PAYEMS) signals strong labor demand that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS rises from previous month, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate output and profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
